requirements.text: Keep every word in order and greedily fit as many words as possible on each line.
Make every output line exactly maxWidth characters long.
Distribute spaces evenly on ordinary lines, assigning the remainder to leftmost gaps.
Left-align the last line and any single-word line, preserving right padding.

variables.S: Total characters in rendered output lines

reference_complexity.auxiliary_space: O(W) working space, excluding input and returned output
reference_complexity.notes: Reference guidance, not an analysis of the submitted program. Include stored input, returned values, JSON serialization buffers, and recursion stacks in total space. Hash-table bounds, where stated, are expected rather than worst-case guarantees. Hard follows LeetCode; the 60-minute practice estimate is provisional.
